cuts.title: Cinna's friends surprised her after a sub record, then again at 100K
cuts.hook: Friends surprise Cinna after sub record
cuts.retelling: Cinna's friends surprise her on stream with flowers and silly string for a huge sub record, then days later give her a 100K plaque that leaves her shocked and happy.

cuts.label: scout:buddha+xqc/buddha-xqc-about-food-2026w37
cuts.title: xQc hyped a coin, Buddha lost $800
cuts.hook: xQc pumps a coin, Buddha loses $800
cuts.retelling: xQc hyped an in-game coin called Snack and told viewers to buy, it crashed, Buddha says he bought in and lost $800, and xQc later admits he pumped it and rug pulled the whole thing.

cuts.label: squeex@momentgiantrockynostrilpeopleschamp-5perlkbvc7c1b3sb/squeex-charact-escap-2026w41
cuts.title: Scotty takes advice from a prisoner and the prison walks out
cuts.hook: Scotty took advice from a prisoner
cuts.retelling: A streamer playing a prisoner coaches Scotty to bluff the union by threatening to fire everyone, and when Scotty does it the staff say the place sucks and walk out.

cuts.label: marlon@vod2874156058/marlon-about-call-2026w38
cuts.title: Marlon walked the show and couldn't breathe in the outfit
cuts.hook: Marlon loved this outfit... until the stylist
cuts.retelling: Marlon loved the black outfit he was given at a fashion show, but then a stylist dressed him so tightly that he couldn't breathe.

cuts.label: caseoh@momentcredulousreliablewrenminglee-xysv6pdttvmqaxto/caseoh-about-caseoh-2026w37
cuts.title: CaseOh Is Sure His Passenger Is A Thief
cuts.hook: CaseOh decides his passenger's a thief
cuts.retelling: CaseOh, playing a horror taxi game, decides his passenger is a thief because of how he looks out the window, reports him, and the game says his hunch isn't proof.

cuts.label: joebartolozzi@momentpuzzleddirtydumplingsyee-6syvqlxmlhvcv2is/joebartolozzi-bartolozzi-food-2026w41
cuts.title: Joe reacts to the $80 blueberry spill in the MrBeast grocery store challenge
cuts.retelling: In MrBeast's grocery-store challenge, every calorie that spoils costs the contestants a dollar, so after spilling $80 of blueberries they freeze their produce and bread to keep the food from going bad.

cuts.label: ohnepixel@vod2889800273/ohnepixel-bikini-charact-2026w40
cuts.title: ohnepixel swears he's done with this game... then asks for a massage
cuts.hook: Pixel swears he's done with this game
cuts.retelling: A streamer loudly swears off a risqué game, says 'I'm not playing', then says 'Continuing' and later is back in it asking for a massage.

cuts.title: Kai Cenat to Reggie: where's your proof?
cuts.hook: Kai Cenat tells Reggie: show your proof
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat tells someone named Reggie he's lying about a phone call and demands the proof he promised, then threatens to call the cops and sue him.
